metadata.description: Comprehensive evidence repository of Sony PlayMemories Camera Apps (PMCA) homebrew applications: seed resolutions, new verified homebrew candidates, and ecosystem caveats.

environment.platform: Sony PlayMemories Camera Apps (PMCA) / Android 2.3.7 (API 10) & Android 4.1.2 (API 16)
environment.validation_standard: Expected manifest package, declared Android minimum API 1-10, and parsable APK signing certificate. This audit is not a full cryptographic signature or publisher-trust verification.

seed_resolutions.name: PMCADemo
seed_resolutions.author: ma1co
seed_resolutions.support_caveats: Demo application for Sony camera developers with camera liveview, sensors, keypad and Wi-Fi tests. Clean HDMI mode keeps top menu bar.

parsed_manifest.certificate_subject: Common Name: ma1co

seed_resolutions.name: dof-math
seed_resolutions.author: Bostwickenator
seed_resolutions.support_caveats: Depth-of-field calculation tool running in-camera. Simple utility.

parsed_manifest.certificate_subject: Country: USA

seed_resolutions.name: STG Uploader
seed_resolutions.author: Bostwickenator
seed_resolutions.support_caveats: Google Photos direct uploader. Google OAuth deprecation of embedded webviews on Android 2.3/4.x creates sign-in authentication failures unless custom OAuth proxy/credentials are used.

parsed_manifest.certificate_subject: Common Name: Alex Gee, Country: NZ

seed_resolutions.name: FTP Uploader
seed_resolutions.author: Bostwickenator
seed_resolutions.support_caveats: Uploads photos from camera SD card to user-specified FTP server over Wi-Fi.

parsed_manifest.certificate_subject: Common Name: Alex Gee, Country: NZ

seed_resolutions.name: SynologyUploader
seed_resolutions.author: LubikR
seed_resolutions.support_caveats: Uploads photos directly from camera to Synology NAS PhotoStation/FileStation via local Wi-Fi.

parsed_manifest.certificate_subject: Common Name: Lubos Renner, Locality: Beroun, Country: CZE

seed_resolutions.name: pmcaFilesystemServer
seed_resolutions.author: schnatterer
seed_resolutions.support_caveats: Exposes camera file system via embedded HTTP server (port 8080) for wireless downloading of photos over LAN.

parsed_manifest.certificate_subject: Common Name: Android Debug, Organization: Android, Country: US

new_verified_candidates.name: AstroFish
new_verified_candidates.author: yxy / 想飞的咸鱼 (astrofish-tools)
new_verified_candidates.description: Star View low-light preview, clean preview, manual focus magnification, live luminance histogram, timed BULB (31s-6h), and long-exposure intervalometer.
new_verified_candidates.compatibility: Developed and verified on Sony α7R (ILCE-7R) firmware 3.2. Alpha 7R II, 7S, 7S II capable with caveat to use formatted empty SD card. Android API 10.

parsed_manifest.certificate_subject: Common Name: yxy, Organizational Unit: AstroFish, Organization: yxy, Locality: Shanghai, Country: CN

new_verified_candidates.name: CanonDirectPrint
new_verified_candidates.author: ben-hawks
new_verified_candidates.description: In-camera photo selection and direct wireless printing to Canon SELPHY Wi-Fi printers (AirPrint/IPP/CPNP) and Canon Ivy 2 Zink printers.
new_verified_candidates.compatibility: Tested on Sony α7 (ILCE-7). Canon SELPHY CP1300 tested over AirPrint/IPP; CP900/CP910/CP1200/CP1500 supported via CPNP/AirPrint. Canon Ivy 2 supported via phone bridge. Android API 10.

parsed_manifest.certificate_subject: Common Name: CanonDirectPrint

new_verified_candidates.name: LensCatalog
new_verified_candidates.author: Grohle-developer
new_verified_candidates.description: Manual and adapted lens catalog that injects EXIF metadata before capture and configures IBIS steady-shot focal length for vintage glass.
new_verified_candidates.compatibility: Developed and tested on Sony A7 II (ILCE-7M2). Designed for PMCA bodies with IBIS/EXIF. Android 2.3.7 / API 10.

parsed_manifest.certificate_subject: Common Name: lenscatalog debug

new_verified_candidates.name: CustomLut (A6000-LUT)
new_verified_candidates.author: starshine09074-ui
new_verified_candidates.description: Loads custom .cube 3D LUT files from SD card (/LUTS/), decomposes them via constrained ALS into a 1024-point gamma table + 3x3 RGB matrix written directly into the camera ISP hardware pipeline via CameraEx for real-time liveview and JPEG shooting.
new_verified_candidates.compatibility: Tested and verified on Sony A6000 (ILCE-6000) firmware 3.21. Other PMCA bodies (A7/RX series) have interface but unverified. Android API 10.

parsed_manifest.certificate_subject: Common Name: Debug, Organization: CustomLut, Country: CN

new_verified_candidates.name: Grain Lab
new_verified_candidates.author: brycewalkerdev
new_verified_candidates.description: Standalone post-capture film effect lab adding procedural grain, halation, bloom, diffusion, vignette, and film defects with native camera catalog registration.
new_verified_candidates.compatibility: Tested on Sony A5000 (ILCE-5000). Targets Android API 10 with optimized ARMv7 hardware-FP and ARMv5 fallback native image processing. Full Sony catalog and orientation integration.

caveat_and_excluded_candidates.name: Film Studio / 胶片工坊
caveat_and_excluded_candidates.author: ukiki0718-netizen
caveat_and_excluded_candidates.exclusion_reason: Modified commercial vendor app derivation (derived from PictureEffectPlus mod) with PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0 license. Uses package namespace com.yuki.imaging.app.pictureeffectplus.

caveat_and_excluded_candidates.name: PictureEffectPlus Ricoh Mod
caveat_and_excluded_candidates.author: bonyback1
caveat_and_excluded_candidates.exclusion_reason: Modified official Sony commercial package (com.sony.imaging.app.pictureeffectplus). Because it uses Sony vendor package namespace, standard Sony-PMCA USB installer fails with Error 100 due to scalarainstaller master key verification; requires Wi-Fi ADB sideloading. Also subject to vendor copyright/licensing restrictions.
